articles.title: KID re-entry capsule transmitted data after separation from PSLV-C62: Spanish start up
articles.summary: Spanish startup Orbital Paradigm claims its Kestrel Initial Technology Demonstrator (KID) capsule survived the failed PSLV-C62 mission. Despite the rocket's failure, the company asserts the KID separated and transmitted data. This unconfirmed report, awaiting official verification from ISRO, highlights potential for unexpected payload resilience even during mission anomalies, a notable event in space technology.

articles.title: Review – DC KO #3: Tag Team Terror
articles.summary: A recent comic book review details the ongoing 'DC KO' event, now progressing to its quarter-final stage. After eight preliminary one-shots and tie-ins, only eight contenders remain. These remaining participants are set to face a critical and challenging test involving the powerful 'Heart of Apokalips', signaling an intense competition within the DC universe.

articles.title: India Approves Boeing 767 Tankers to Fill Long-Standing Refueling Capability Gap
articles.summary: India's Ministry of Defence approved acquiring six Boeing B-767 airliners for conversion into aerial refuellers by Israel Aerospace Industries. This crucial step enhances the Indian Air Force's operational reach and endurance, significantly boosting its strategic capabilities for long-range missions and power projection. The move underscores India's commitment to modernizing its aerial assets and strengthens defence cooperation.

articles.title: Russia says attack on oil tanker near CPC was carried out by Ukrainian drones
articles.summary: The Russian Ministry of Defence reported an attack on its 'Matilda' oil tanker in the Black Sea on January 13th. Moscow stated two Ukrainian unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) were responsible, striking the vessel approximately 100 km offshore. This incident highlights ongoing naval tensions and drone warfare tactics in the conflict zone, underscoring the strategic importance of Black Sea shipping routes amidst the Ukraine war.

articles.title: Pre-Order Alert: McFarlane Toys DC Direct Platinum Edition The Flash 7-in Action Figure With Comic
articles.summary: The article announces the pre-order availability of the new McFarlane Toys DC Direct Platinum Edition The Flash 7-inch Action Figure, which includes a comic. Now available at Gamestop, this release targets collectors and fans of the DC universe, offering a new collectible for enthusiasts to acquire as part of their merchandise.

articles.title: 'We must strengthen Arctic defences to deter Putin' Foreign Secretary says during Arctic visit
articles.summary: Britain's Foreign Secretary emphasized the critical importance of Arctic security for protecting the UK and NATO during her visit to the High North. She pledged support for allies in the region, highlighting its strategic significance. Additionally, Labour's Yvette Cooper is set to advocate for increased NATO engagement and a stronger presence in the Arctic, underlining the growing security concerns.

articles.title: Pre-Order Alert: McFarlane Toys DC Direct Page Punchers Green Lantern and Flash Figures
articles.summary: A customer expressed high satisfaction with Best Buy's service, reporting a swift delivery of their "Professor Pyg" order. Placed on the 7th, the item was received by the 9th, demonstrating efficient logistics and quick fulfillment in the e-commerce sector. This positive consumer experience highlights the operational capabilities of major retailers in meeting customer expectations for prompt service.
